description.en: The ID of the cloud disk.
The ID of the ENS node. You can call [DescribeEnsRegions](~~2637662~~) to query ENS node IDs.
A JSON array that contains 1 to 100 ENS node IDs.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh: 快照标识编码。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: A single snapshot ID, or a JSON array containing up to 100 snapshot IDs.

description.zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot begin with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-snapshots --ens-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --snapshot-id sp-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --ens-region-ids cn-suzhou-telecom_,_cn-chengdu-telecom --snapshot-name testSnapshotName --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
